Stand still to charge, then launch a slash in the direction you face.[nl]Opponents can dodge it or take cover behind a wall. Misses still use the cooldown.

Egoist
Survive suspicion, then persuade the meeting to eject your rival.

Votes from other players build [color=#CC4D99]Ego[/color] if you survive the meeting.[nl]Once you have enough, publicly challenge another player. Get them ejected that meeting to win.[nl]Everyone can still vote for anyone or Skip. A failed challenge spends all your Ego.

[color=#CC4D99]Ego:[/color] Receive votes and survive to charge your challenge.[nl][color=#CC4D99]Win:[/color] Challenge someone, then get them ejected that meeting.[nl]Everyone can vote normally. Failure spends all your Ego.

Injector
Collect research samples, then submit your results.

[color=#E64D1A]Choose Adrenaline or Sedative[/color], then inject a player.[nl]Wait for the observation to finish and return to collect their sample before it expires. Each player counts once.[nl]Targets can cleanse the serum. Failed experiments can be retried.[nl]After collecting enough samples, use [color=#E64D1A]Submit Research[/color] and stay in place until it finishes. Everyone is warned.

[color=#E64D1A]Serum:[/color] Choose speed or slowdown, inject, wait, then collect a sample.[nl]Each player counts once. They can cleanse; failed attempts can be retried.[nl][color=#E64D1A]Win:[/color] Collect enough samples, then submit while standing still.[nl]Everyone is warned. Stay alive until submission finishes.

Prankster
Fool different players into reporting your fake bodies.

Place a fake body where someone might believe a kill happened.[nl]A report removes the fake and earns a point. [color=#FF8C00]The reporter stays alive[/color], and each player can only score for you once.[nl]Players can inspect a body up close. Finding a fake removes it without giving you a point.[nl]Reach the report goal while alive to win.

[color=#FF8C00]Prank:[/color] Leave one fake body. Reports score without killing anyone.[nl]Each reporter scores once. Inspecting a fake removes it without scoring.[nl][color=#FF8C00]Win:[/color] Reach your report goal while alive.

Shade
Set up a shadow zone and catch players inside it.

Place a [color=#A64DF2]shadow zone[/color]. Its boundary appears before it activates.[nl]While inside, you are hidden from other players and can kill targets in the same zone. Leaving the zone makes them safe from your attack.[nl]Place another zone after the cooldown. Reach your kill goal while alive to win.

[color=#A64DF2]Zone:[/color] Place a bubble; it activates after a short warning.[nl]Inside, you are hidden and can kill players in the same bubble.[nl][color=#A64DF2]Win:[/color] Reach your kill goal. Deploy again after the cooldown.[nl]Leaving stops your attack. Meetings and your death remove the zone.

Tyrant
Build pressure through kills and offer a public alliance.

Your first kill unlocks [color=#C71A29]Intimidate[/color]: a visible warning followed by a brief slowdown inside the marked area. Your next two kills increase its range.[nl]After four kills, offer one player an alliance. They can accept or reject it, and everyone keeps their normal vote.[nl]If they accept, you both win by surviving a later meeting. You can also win alone by being the last player alive.

[color=#E85C68]Intimidate:[/color] 1 kill unlocks a warned slowdown. Kills 2-3 widen it.[nl][color=#E85C68]Alliance:[/color] At 4 kills, offer one player a choice to join you.[nl][color=#E85C68]Win:[/color] Both survive a later meeting, or be the last player alive.

Wraith Caller
Collect a body trace, then send a Wraith after a target.

Collect a [color=#9433E6]trace[/color] from a dead body, then choose who your Wraith hunts.[nl]The Wraith passes through walls, but the target is warned and can escape by surviving the hunt.[nl]You can send one Wraith at a time. A failed hunt returns your trace; a successful hunt uses it up.[nl]Meetings and your death end the hunt. Reach your Wraith kill goal while alive to win.

[color=#BD80FF]Hunt:[/color] Collect a body trace, choose a target, send one Wraith.[nl]It crosses walls. The warned target escapes by surviving the timer.[nl]Failure refunds the trace. Meetings and your death stop the hunt.[nl][color=#BD80FF]Win:[/color] Reach your Wraith kill goal while alive.

Bounty
Follow your target, then catch them during a timed chase.

Stay near your assigned target to prepare the contract. Staying away too long reduces your progress.[nl]When it is ready, your target gets a warning and a head start before [color=#FFB14F]Cash Out[/color] unlocks.[nl]Catch them before the chase ends to win. Tracking gives brief updates rather than a constant location.[nl]A failed contract gives you another chance with a new target.

[color=#FFB14F]Prepare:[/color] Stay near your target; long absences lose progress.[nl][color=#FFB14F]Chase:[/color] They get a warning and head start, then Cash Out unlocks.[nl][color=#FFB14F]Win:[/color] Catch them before time runs out. Arbitrator
Predict who will be ejected or survive the meeting.

During discussion, choose [color=#FF6868]Accuse[/color] or [color=#66BFFF]Defend[/color] and select a player. Your judgment locks before voting opens.[nl]Accuse scores if they are ejected. Defend scores if they receive enough votes but survive. Each target can only earn you one token.[nl]Your judgment does not change anyone's vote. Reach your token goal and survive the meeting to win.

Choose a mode, then a player during the opening selection window.[nl][color=#FF6868]Accuse:[/color] They get ejected. Collector
Collect one fragment of each kind and survive a meeting.

Deaths leave [color=#F23D3D]Violence[/color], [color=#B833F0]Ability[/color] or [color=#4F9DFF]Fate[/color] fragments.[nl]Keep one of each and use Manifest, then survive the next meeting to win. Everyone is warned when your collection is complete.[nl]Convert spare duplicates into a missing kind, or spend pairs on Trace or Drift. Conversion keeps one of the kind you trade.[nl]Harvesting briefly reveals you to nearby players.

Nomad
Complete journeys and survive a meeting to win.

Set an [color=#65D5EB]anchor[/color], then visit new rooms. Travel far enough between stops and spend a short time at each destination.[nl]Backtracking keeps your progress. Once the route is ready, use Wander to return to your anchor and score.[nl]Each return briefly arms Backtrack, which saves you from one normal kill.[nl]Complete enough routes, then survive the next meeting to win.

[color=#65D5EB]Route:[/color] Anchor, visit new rooms, then Wander back to score.[nl]Travel between stops and stay briefly. Revisits keep progress.[nl][color=#65D5EB]Win:[/color] Finish your routes and survive the next meeting.[nl]Returning briefly blocks one normal kill.

Your existence is publicly announced. Survive meetings to reveal your final objective. Reach it, then protect your armor until the countdown ends.

Usurper
Claim a crown, hold it publicly, then survive a later meeting.

Claim a player and collect their crown after they die. Other players can secure it first.[nl]Taking the crown reveals your name to everyone. Hold it for the configured duration outside meetings, then survive a meeting that starts afterward.[nl]Meetings pause the timer. Death or exile stops your victory.

[color=#F0B26E]Claim:[/color] Choose a player. Their death drops a crown.[nl]Stand still beside it alone to collect it. Others can secure it first.[nl][color=#F0B26E]Hold:[/color] Everyone learns your name; the crown appears above you.[nl]Finish the hold timer outside meetings, then survive a later meeting to win.

Claim a player and collect their crown after they die. Stand still beside it alone to pick it up; others can secure it first.[nl]Taking the crown reveals your name and displays the crown above you while visible.[nl]Hold it for at least 20 seconds outside meetings, then survive a meeting that starts afterward. Meetings pause the timer; death or exile stops your victory.
